description: Extracts product tags and metadata from product JSON

extract_tags.description: Extracts product tags from metadata JSON
extract_tags.prompt:
You are an AI metadata extraction agent.
Here is the raw metadata JSON of the current product: {PRODUCT_META}
Extract the 'autogen:subject' or related subject/tag properties from this JSON.

IMPORTANT: Return ONLY a valid JSON array. No explanations, no markdown, no extra text.
Format: ["green", "pants", "cargo"]
If none found, return []
Start your response with [ and end with ]
